preconditions.description: The number of vertices n must be between 3 and 300.

postconditions.description: The number of cycles k must be greater than 0.
The number of cycles k must be less than or equal to n squared.

postconditions.expression: all(3 <= m <= 4 for m in cycle_lengths)
postconditions.description: Each cycle length m must be either 3 or 4.

postconditions.expression: all(1 <= v <= n for cycle in cycles for v in cycle[1:])
postconditions.description: Each vertex v in the cycles must be between 1 and n.
Each edge must appear in exactly two cycles.
